title: Chapter 152 - 152 Mission Completed; Lin Fan, Thank You!
content:
Chapter 152 - 152 Mission Completed; Lin Fan, Thank You!

Chapter 152 - 152 Mission Completed; Lin Fan, Thank You!

152 Mission Completed; Lin Fan, Thank You!

Chu Yunyue’s pretty face was filled with excitement when she mentioned the new product.

She held Lin Fan’s hand and said, “Come here and look at the information.”

Then, the two of them went to the computer and sat on the same soft executive chair, sticking close to each other.

Lin Fan felt a cold, jade-like sensation in his heart.

Chu Yunyue stretched out her slender fingers and quickly moved the mouse.

After a while, high-definition images appeared on the computer screen.

“The new product that Flower Stem is launching this time is not perfume but skincare!” Chu Yunyue introduced.

“This skincare product is made from pure natural herbal essences. The product has the fragrance of herbs. At the same time, it’s moisturizing, softening, brightening, and so on…”

The more Chu Yunyue spoke, the more excited she became. Her beautiful eyes glowed faintly.

Lin Fan could not hear what she was saying clearly. He was just looking at her serious and excited expression and was a little lost in thought.

At this moment, Chu Yunyue suddenly turned to the side and exhaled a mouthful of fragrance. “Lin Fan, what do you think? ”

Looking at Lin Fan’s burning gaze, she thought of something and blushed.

Then, she leaned her head forward.

Her hand accidentally touched the mouse.

Immediately, the computer screen began to play Animal World.

“Spring is here. Everything is recovering. It’s time for animals to reproduce…”

…

About two hours later, Lin Fan and Chu Yunyue walked out of the president’s office.

At this moment, Chu Yunyue’s pretty face was still blushing. Her snow-white skin was covered in sweat as if she had just done some intense exercise.

“Our skincare product will be scented. You’re an expert in perfumes. You have to give more suggestions later,” Chu Yunyue said.

Lin Fan nodded. “No problem.”

The two of them chatted as they walked. After a while, they arrived at the research and development center.

The last time Lin Fan came, the research and development center only had some simple chemical equipment.

At this moment, there were many pieces of large-scale equipment.

The researchers were carefully adjusting the equipment and analyzing the data.

“Everyone, stop what you’re doing,” Chu Yunyue said. “Let’s complete the steps for our latest skincare product from start to finish.”

She remembered very clearly that Lin Fan had discovered the shortcomings of the perfume during the production process.

Therefore, Chu Yunyue had to show Lin Fan the complete steps.

“Alright,” all the researchers responded in unison.

They divided their work in an orderly manner.

First, they took out the different plant essences that had been placed in the vials and separated them into different colors.

After that, the effective components were extracted by heating and evaporating.

Then, they mixed various medicinal liquids according to different proportions.

About an hour later, a bottle of water-like essence appeared in front of Lin Fan.

At the same time, a crisp notification rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! You’ve completed the hidden mission: watch the complete steps to the skincare product’s production. You’ve obtained the right to purchase Beauty Water.]

[Beauty Water: it can brighten skin, remove freckles… It has the special effect of revitalizing the skin. Cost: 10,000 yuan. [Note: If you spend money to buy Beauty Water, you won’t receive a red packet.]

Chu Yunyue saw that Lin Fan did not go to get the skincare product. Instead, he just stood there in a daze.

“Lin Fan, what’s wrong?” she asked.

“Oh… It’s nothing.” Lin Fan finally reacted and said, “Don’t release this skincare product for now. I’ll show you something later.”

After saying that, Lin Fan strode out of Feiyang Building.

He bought a two-liter bottle of mineral water from a nearby supermarket and gave the water to the supermarket owner. He left only with the empty bottle.

Then, he went to the car and spent 20,000 yuan to buy two liters of Beauty Water before returning to Flower Stem.

Chu Yunyue saw Lin Fan return with a large bottle of mineral water in his hand. She could not help but ask, “Lin Fan, you…”

Lin Fan said, “This is a skincare product that I got someone to develop. Try it and see how it works.”

This was a skincare product?

Chu Yunyue was stunned.

She had seen many skincare products packaged in gorgeous metal containers, and she had also seen skincare products in exquisite porcelain bottles…

However, this was the first time she had seen someone put a skincare product in a mineral water bottle.

If it was someone else who said that their mineral water bottle was filled with a skincare product, Chu Yunyue would probably ignore them.

However, if it was Lin Fan… Chu Yunyue carefully poured a few drops into her palm. Then, she looked in the mirror and gently patted her pretty face.

Instantly, she felt a refreshing feeling on her face.

The next moment, Chu Yunyue’s beautiful eyes widened as she cried out in surprise, “How is this possible?”

Ever since the rainbow perfumes were launched, Flower Stem became famous in Hua Nation.

Many channels and sellers came to seek cooperation.

Due to this, Chu Yunyue was extremely busy and often stayed up late.

After a few days, Chu Yunyue’s skin became rough and dark. She even had two pimples.

When Chu Yunyue used the Beauty Water that Lin Fan had brought, her skin seemed to have been injected with vitality. It became fair and smooth again, and even the spots disappeared completely.

She became even more perfect than before her skin deteriorated!

Her skin was as translucent as jade! This was the best way to describe Chu Yunyue!

The reason why Chu Yunyue chose to enter the cosmetics industry was not that she was vain.

It was because she had been researching all kinds of cosmetics both domestically and abroad for a long time.

She knew that Estee Lauder had the ability to resist aging and repair, that Lebernie had the ability to activate skin metabolism and prevent aging, and that CBG could make skin glow…

However, only after using these skincare products for a long time could they achieve a little corresponding effect.

What was the situation now?

She had only applied a little bit of skincare product, but in a few minutes, there had been an earth-shattering change!

This…

How was this a skincare product?

It was simply the water of the immortal gods!

After a while, Chu Yunyue came back to her senses and said, “Lin Fan, this essence…”

Lin Fan said, “If you think it’s okay, I’ll get someone to send a large batch over regularly. Then, Flower Stem will sell it.”

Could she?

This was simply too good!

Chu Yunyue’s breathing quickened.

She could almost imagine how popular this essence would be once it was released!

Soon, however, she hesitated and said, “This is the product you developed. If you let me sell it directly, will it…”

Lin Fan touched Chu Yunyue’s tender face and smiled. “Why do we have to draw such clear lines? Besides, don’t I still have 30% of the company’s shares?”

When Chu Yunyue heard this, she threw herself into Lin Fan’s arms and said gently, “Lin Fan, thank you. “
